fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (ROOFTOP, 32.075124,-96.457637) lands directly on a very large modern single-block distribution warehouse — confirmed in satellite z16-z19. Address 2200 S. Business 45, Corsicana. Building is ~1,150 ft x ~400 ft.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully fenced; the building sits ~250 m back from S. Business 45 behind a deep landscaped buffer. A single entrance driveway off Business 45 at the SE corner reaches the yard through a perimeter-fence gate (pinch-point). truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small dark structure sits at the entrance driveway split (visible z19-z20) — could be a gatehouse/guard booth or a parked trailer/equipment shed; not definitively a multi-window staffed booth. Flagged uncertain. Best read: no staffed shack -> remote check-in.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no clearly-confirmed staffed booth -> remoteGs = true. Medium confidence; the ambiguous structure at the entrance could be a booth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-leveler runs along the SW and SE faces of the warehouse; this is a 50+ door cross-dock-scale DC. Exact count not resolvable; estimate ~70.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard along the SW dock face — dozens of trailers in organized parking rows (z18-z19). dropArea banded 50+.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long entrance approach from Business 45 across a deep buffer and wide internal road — ample 3+ truck stacking room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved aprons and a long approach road; abundant room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the far western property edge but no spur turns into the warehouse property — railServed = false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Southwest edge of Corsicana along Business 45; surrounded by woods, scattered industrial parcels and farmland. Edge-of-town / rural.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks are concentrated on the SW face with some wrap onto the SE; reads as one continuous dock operation, not physically separated ship/receive banks.
